# Google Photos protocol references

The read-only request layouts and response field positions in `googlephotos-extension` are adapted from xob0t's MIT-licensed [google_photos_web_client](https://github.com/xob0t/google_photos_web_client/tree/651aa268d50529cb6128c8a42c9cd4ce668f2189), particularly `gpwc/client.py`, `payloads.py` and `parser.py`. Its copyright and MIT license are retained in `LICENSE`, also packaged in the extension APK.

[gpmc](https://github.com/xob0t/gpmc/tree/94b1b267ca6819da542d4330a7dd216747eb0437) informed the research into mobile authentication and retrieval. No Python runtime, Python dependency or Google APK contents are included in this extension.
